# Third-party notices

This project uses LEAP 71 PicoGK 2.3.0 through its NuGet package and native runtime.
PicoGK remains subject to its own license and notices. No PicoGK source is copied into
this folder.

The verification scripts use CadQuery, VTK, and NumPy from the existing local CAD
environment. Their source is not redistributed here.

The retained rotor-plate STEP is an internal Annihilation Industries reference input,
not a third-party dependency bundled into the 3MF.
